title: Tensorator and unit of the common-stage completed tensor lift
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_tensor_unit
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry) :
    Nonempty (CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry)

source.place: BS Remark 6.8.15; HRS Lemma 7.9; common-field tensor descent.

proof.text: Construct the specified invertible tensor components from the finite normalized comparisons and the actual common-stage transports. The separate naturality equality makes NatIso.ofComponents into the required tensorator.

The ordinary coefficient-unit comparison is proved from fully faithful coherent reduction and scalar multiplication on the regular coefficient module. Compose it with coherence.unitIso to obtain the unit field, and assemble the structure.

proof_origin.place: Explicit finite/common-field invertible components, their naturality, and the independently proved coefficient-unit calculation.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact declaration in the library.

from.place: the finite normalized tensor comparison and coefficient unit
